source.name: Ballparks of Baseball – 'Great American Ball Park'
source.quote: Great American Insurance purchased the naming rights to the new stadium for $75 million over 30 years, giving it the name Great American Ball Park.

note: Arena naming rights: Great American Ball Park. Start date unknown: the record said 2026 (the season it was recorded), its source is from 2023-01-01. The same page's facts panel gives the current terms: 'Naming Rights: Great American Insurance, $2.5 million/year through 2033'.
